g.text: UC3 — Hotel Detail & Fresh Room Rates
HotelMap geocodes by hotel name, not lat/lng
Poll fresh room rates once, shared via context (never reuse list prices)
raw room JSON (warming up; may be empty)
gallery falls back to room photos when the hotel
image CDN 403s; de-dupes across both sources
room cards + "Rate confirmed at HH:MM" badge
